channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russia kills 12 in Ukraine as Kyiv mourns 707 children killed since 2022
item.description: Russia's latest attacks come as Ukraine commemorates the children killed by Russia over the course of the all-out war.

item.title: Marjane Satrapi, the author of ‘Persepolis,’ dies at 56
item.description: Known for her graphic novel ‘Persepolis,’ Iranian-French artist and filmmaker Marjane Satrapi has died at the age of 56.

item.title: ‘Unpatriotic’: Trump decries Republicans who voted to constrain Iran war
item.description: Trump takes aim at lawmakers after House passes war powers resolution; advocates call on Senate to advance the measure.

item.title: Iran footballers describe how war with US-Israel affects their World Cup
item.description: Iran national players Saeid Ezatolahi and Mohammad Ghorbani talk about how war is overshadowing a World Cup dream.

item.title: Hezbollah rejects renewed ceasefire agreed by Israel and Lebanon
item.description: The United States announced the ceasefire agreement on Wednesday night following a fresh round of talks.

item.title: Trump hits back at 'unpatriotic' vote after House rebukes him over Iran
item.description: The lower chamber of Congress passed a measure that seeks to halt further military action, in a vote seen as largely symbolic.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill 11 people in Gaza City, medics say
item.description: Women and children were among those killed in the attacks on four residential buildings, which Israel's military says killed four Hamas security officials.

item.title: Oscar-nominated Persepolis author Marjane Satrapi dies aged 56
item.description: The French-Iranian author and illustrator was known for her graphic novel series and Oscar-nominated film.

item.title: One killed and dozens injured in Iranian drone strikes on Kuwait airport
item.description: Iran says the attack on Kuwait was in retaliation for earlier US strikes on an Iranian oil tanker and island.

item.title: Foreign nationals among at least 21 killed in Delhi fire
item.description: Many victims were South Asians who had travelled to India for treatment or to accompany relatives.
